declared_rules_at_run.EN3_tail_threshold: per endpoint and variant, the pooled 90th percentile of per-cell scores in the two Experiment-1 WT baseline libraries (GSM7890829, GSM7890830); fixed, then applied to every library
declared_rules_at_run.SMD: difference of group means divided by pooled SD (cells); descriptive effect size, not a test
declared_rules_at_run.unavailable: group below the 30-cell floor on either side, or a required library missing

interpretation: library-level descriptive estimates; Cd177 RNA is not surface protein; associations are not causal or lineage evidence
